source_contract.quantity: lower external advective air flux through the modeled soil column
source_contract.scientific_owner: GHGasses Task 1 temporary derived air-flow field
source_contract.first_read: GHGasses Task 1 bottom-layer transformation reads Flair(Ln+1) at Ln=Nl
source_contract.write_gap: After La=Max(0,La-1), 0 <= La <= Nl-1. Existing Task 1 zeroing and recurrence therefore assign no index above Flair(Nl) before the Flair(Nl+1) read.

causal_defect.mechanism: same-call first-use omission of the lower external air-interface coordinate
causal_defect.positive_residual_effect: acts as unconfigured bottom advective gas outflow/sink and changes the bottom transport disappearance coefficient
causal_defect.negative_residual_effect: is transformed to lower inflow even though the bottom equation has no modeled lower-neighbour gas concentration source

activation.scope: only the qualified lower-boundary first-use seam and direct bottom transport coefficients
activation.natural_case_gap: GHG01 records that the supplied historical GHG case does not reach the revision-53 GHG branch because its parser contract is incompatible.
activation.qualification_interpretation: Purpose-built seam activation is used to avoid composition with unresolved TCD-032 through TCD-037. It is causal and coverage evidence only, never historical B2.

direct_changed_when_first_use_residual_i: bottom advective gas transfer contribution ToFl
direct_unchanged: gas production and reaction source equations
expected_difference_surface.allowed_later_changes: Only causal descendants of removal of the spurious lower GHG air-boundary exchange.
expected_difference_surface.zero_residual_case: If the undefined legacy storage happens to expose 0.0 in a process image, the bounded correction has no local numerical difference while still making first use defined.

conservation.identity: A closed lower air boundary has q_b = 0, therefore advective gas exchange through that external face is exactly zero for any gas concentration.
conservation.reason_full_ledgers_out_of_scope: GHG01 records independent unresolved source, restart, observer, and task-state findings. TCD-041 neither resolves nor composes them.

non_interference.scope: outside the lower GHG air-advection boundary and its causal descendants

first_use_safety.candidate: write Flair(Nl+1)=0.0 before the bottom transformation, or equivalently extend the existing zeroing coverage through the lower external face
first_use_safety.proof_obligation: Every active GHGasses Task 1 invocation reaches the bottom transformation with Flair(Nl+1) defined as the qualified closed-boundary value.
